'''The Rusty Bucket''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Takari]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]].<ref name="Plant" /> The bar had a reputation as a business of ill repute.<ref name="Magnificent">{{SW|url=news/the-not-so-magnificent-seven|text=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|int=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|nolive=1}}</ref> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Chilla]] was working as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at The Rusty Bucket in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered her, wounding her which led to her [[Death/Legends|death]] in the local sewers. The Rusty Bucket burned down shortly after.<ref name="Plant" /> The [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tutti Snibit]] was known to frequent The Rusty Bucket.<ref name="Magnificent" />
